gui.mechanical.tool_station.head: Head
gui.mechanical.kiln.unlit: Not lit: add fuel and light it with a Fire Drill
message.mechanical.kiln.needs_campfire: The kiln must be placed on a campfire
message.mechanical.kiln.needs_fuel: Put fuel in the kiln first
message.mechanical.knife_too_weak: This hide is too tough for your knife
message.mechanical.too_advanced: You don't know how to use this yet
message.mechanical.offering_altar.waitin: The altar waits for a worthy offering.
item.mechanical.thunderstone.lore: Struck from the sky, it calls the sky back down.
item.mechanical.mistletoe_charm.lore: Carried close, it mends wounds and turns poison.
item.mechanical.ancient_amber.lore: A sleeping insect; beasts take you for a quiet thing.
item.mechanical.heart_of_the_oak.lore: It still beats. Saplings wake at its touch.
item.mechanical.antler_crown.lore: See as the deer see; walk among them unnoticed.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.hunte: Tread softly. The deer hear everything.
The herd went that way. Follow the blood, not the tracks.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.gathe: The berries are sweet this moon.
Leave some for the bears, stranger.
Not the red mushroom with white spots. Never that one.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.fishe: Quiet. You will scare the fish.
The river gives, if you are patient.
A bone hook and a good line. That is all you need.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.woodc: Strong arms, sharp flint. Good wood.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.elder: Welcome, stranger. The fire is warm, sit with us.
Bring me what you have. We will trade.
I have seen many winters. This one will be hard.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.night: Stay close to the fire. Things walk in the dark.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.killer: Murderer! You will never be welcome here!
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.no_trade: We do not trade with you.
message.mechanical.blood_moon: The moon rises red... the dead are walking tonight.
message.mechanical.kiln.unfired: The clay is still raw: keep a fire burning in the kiln until it is fired
tribe.mechanical.name: %s Tribe
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.greet.frien: Welcome back, friend. Sit by our fire.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.warn: This is our land. Turn back, stranger, or bleed.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.gift: A gift? You are kind. We will remember.
chat.mechanical.tribesperson.no_trade_st: We do not trade with strangers. Earn our trust first.
message.mechanical.pan.need_water: Pan in water: stand in it or aim at it
message.mechanical.flail.need_sheaf: Hold sheaves in your other hand to thresh them
message.mechanical.wind: The wind is rising... fires in the open won't last tonight.
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.empty: Empty: click Crushed Copper / Tin Ore, Concentrate or Native Copper onto it in your inventory
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.melts: Melts in a Clay Kiln at %s°
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.pour: Pour into a Clay Mold before it sets
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.remelt: Melt it again in a Clay Kiln
message.mechanical.mold.not_enough: This mold takes %s units of metal; the crucible holds %s
message.mechanical.mold.set_in_crucible: Too late: the metal has set in the crucible
message.mechanical.bellows.no_kiln: The bellows must blow into a Clay Kiln's firebox or a Smelting Furnace's wall
message.mechanical.kiln.cracked: The kiln is cracked: press 4 Clay Balls into it, then fire it again
message.mechanical.kiln.patched: Patched: keep a fire burning to fire the new clay in
gui.mechanical.kiln.cracked: Cracked: no hotter than 600° until patched with %s Clay Balls
message.mechanical.straw_bed_rest: You rest a while in the straw. The night goes on.
message.mechanical.sanity.afraid: The dark presses in. Find a fire.
message.mechanical.sanity.mad: Your mind is slipping. Was that real?
message.mechanical.sanity.restless: You toss and turn. The shadows won't let you rest.
message.mechanical.dugout.burning: Let the fire burn out first
message.mechanical.dugout.needs_fire: Burn the hewn wood first (torch or fire drill)
message.mechanical.dugout.needs_axe: Hew it out with an axe first
message.mechanical.dugout.needs_knife: Smooth the hollow with a knife
message.mechanical.paintbrush.no_paint: Hold a bowl of paint in your other hand
message.mechanical.paintbrush.no_room: Paint needs a solid face with space in front
message.mechanical.paintbrush.no_room_sc: A scene needs two solid wall faces side by side
message.mechanical.camp.none: No camp here yet: keep a fire burning
message.mechanical.camp.age_noticed: This camp has burned for %s. Its smoke is seen far and wide...
message.mechanical.raid.drums: You hear drums in the dark, from the %s...
message.mechanical.raid.coming: War cries! Raiders of the %s come out of the dark from the %s, with torches!
message.mechanical.raid.defended: The raiders flee! They will think twice before coming back.
message.mechanical.furred_straw_bed_rest: You rest warm under the wolf pelt. The night goes on.
message.mechanical.too_far_gone: This is too far gone to keep
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.slag: %s%% tin: no bronze (8-15%% makes bronze, about 10%% the best). Melts as copper; the tin is lost as slag
tooltip.mechanical.crucible.tin_only: Tin alone casts nothing: add copper (about 9 copper to 1 tin)
message.mechanical.mold.wrong_metal: %s can't be cast in this mold
message.mechanical.drying_rack.pelt_need: This pelt needs a bigger rack
message.mechanical.drying_rack.pelt_no_r: There is no room for the pelt on this rack
message.mechanical.wheel.needs_clay: A %s takes %s Clay Balls (%s on the wheel); sneak with an empty hand to pick another shape
message.mechanical.wheel.enough_clay: There is enough clay on the wheel: hold right-click with an empty hand to throw it
message.mechanical.carcass.carry: On your shoulders. Right-click a block to put it down
message.mechanical.carcass.drag: Dragging it. Right-click it or a block to let go
message.mechanical.hanging_rack.too_big: Too big to hang. Butcher it where it lies
message.mechanical.cart.hitched: The horse is in the shafts. Right-click the cart again to unhitch
message.mechanical.horse.shies: The horse shies away. Crouch and hold out feed
message.mechanical.horse.trust: The horse eats from your hand (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.horse.ready_for_halte: It trusts you now. Put a Rope Halter on it
message.mechanical.horse.needs_halter: Put a Rope Halter on it before feeding it more
message.mechanical.horse.refuses_halter: The horse won't take the halter yet. Feed it first
message.mechanical.horse.haltered: Haltered. Keep feeding it to tame it (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.horse.tamed: The horse is tame. Right-click to ride, sneak + right-click for its gear
message.mechanical.travois.stuck: The travois is stuck. You let go of the poles
message.mechanical.travois.torn_loose: The poles slipped out of your hands
message.mechanical.cart.stuck: The cart is stuck. It came loose from the shafts
message.mechanical.cart.torn_loose: The cart came loose from the shafts
message.mechanical.crucible.too_hot: Let it cool before you knock it out
message.mechanical.carcass.hung: Hung %s min. Ages at 3 min; keeps about %s min more
message.mechanical.carcass.hung_aged: Hung %s min: aged and ready. Keeps about %s min more
message.mechanical.carcass.hung_spoiled: Hung %s min: the meat has spoiled
message.mechanical.furnace.missing: Not a furnace yet: %s Furnace Bricks missing (one at %s %s %s). 3x3x3 around an open shaft, the tap mid-bottom front
message.mechanical.furnace.blocked: The shaft must be open from top to bottom: clear %s %s %s
message.mechanical.furnace.tap_open: Tap open: molten metal runs out into the molds
message.mechanical.furnace.needs_fuel: Drop Charcoal down the shaft first
gui.mechanical.furnace.empty: Empty: drop ore down the shaft
gui.mechanical.furnace.slag: Wrong tin share: lost as slag
gui.mechanical.furnace.unlit: Not lit: Fire Drill on the tap
message.mechanical.fire_pit.no_room: A Fire Pit needs a flat 2×2 of solid ground in front of you
message.mechanical.fire_pit.full: The Fire Pit holds no more firewood (%s)
message.mechanical.bird_nest.uneasy: The birds are getting uneasy about this nest
message.mechanical.bird_nest.abandoned: The birds have abandoned this nest
message.mechanical.root_cellar.not_dug_i: Too much daylight: dig the Root Cellar into the ground to keep food cool
tooltip.mechanical.poor_bronze_kettle: Poor Bronze: holds %s things instead of %s
message.mechanical.tripod.no_fire: A Tripod stands over a Campfire or a Fire Pit
message.mechanical.tripod.one_per_pit: This Fire Pit already has a Tripod
message.mechanical.tripod.empty: Hang a Bronze Kettle in the Tripod
message.mechanical.kettle.has_water: The kettle already has water in it
message.mechanical.kettle.nothing_to_lad: Nothing to ladle out: take what's in it with an empty hand
message.mechanical.kettle.cant_go_in: %s won't make anything in the kettle
message.mechanical.kettle.wrong_mode: %s doesn't belong in %s: empty it first (sneak, empty hand)
message.mechanical.kettle.status.dry: Bronze Kettle: empty (holds %s). Fill it with water
message.mechanical.kettle.status.ladle: Bronze Kettle: %s bowls of %s. Ladle them out with a Bowl
message.mechanical.kettle.status.warm: only warm over embers (%s°): feed the fire
message.mechanical.kettle.status.cold: cold (%s°): light a fire under it
item.mechanical.raven_talisman.lore: Carried, the dark wears on the mind more slowly
message.mechanical.onager.shies: The onager bolts. Crouch and hold out feed
message.mechanical.onager.trust: The onager eats from your hand (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.onager.ready_for_halt: It trusts you now. Put a Rope Halter on it
message.mechanical.onager.needs_halter: Put a Rope Halter on it before feeding it more
message.mechanical.onager.refuses_halter: The onager won't take the halter yet. Feed it first
message.mechanical.onager.haltered: Haltered. Keep feeding it to tame it (trust %s/%s)
message.mechanical.onager.tamed: The onager is tame. Ride it, give it Pack Baskets, or hitch it to a Cart
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.root.d: Bare hands. Pick up Loose Rocks and Loose Flint lying on the ground
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.plant_: Break grass and ferns for Plant Fibre (a knife triples the yield)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.flint_: Craft a Flint Knife from Flint, Twine and a Stick. It stays in the grid as a tool
Craft a Flint Axe (2x2, fits the inventory grid). Logs need an axe
Craft a Flint Pickaxe. It also knaps rocks into stone tool heads
Craft a Flint Shovel or a Flint Hoe
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.firewo: Chop a tree with an axe: its logs split into Firewood
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark.d: Hold right-click with an axe on a Fallen Log to peel off Bark (tinder, bast, baskets)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.bark_b: Craft a Bark Basket for berries, mushrooms and hides. Food keeps longer inside
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.tool_r: Put a knife above any Log in the crafting grid to carve a Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pine_r: Right-click a Pine Log with a knife for Pine Resin. Resin over a Stick makes 2 Torches
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Knap 3 rock chunks with the Flint Pickaxe into a Stone Pickaxe Head or Stone Axe Head
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.double: Knap two heads together with the Flint Pickaxe between them
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.tool_s: Build a Tool Station from a Flint Axe and a Flint Pickaxe. It joins head, binding and shaft
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.crude_: Tool Station: stone head + Twine + Stick makes a Crude Stone Pickaxe or Axe
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.stone_: Tool Station: Double Stone Pickaxe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod
Tool Station: Double Stone Axe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.fire_d: Craft a Fire Drill from Twine and Sticks
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.campfi: Build a Campfire from Sticks and 3 Firewood. It is placed unlit
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.light_: Right-click an unlit Campfire with the Fire Drill. Leaf Litter or Bark as tinder first helps it catch
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.fire_p: Ring a Firewood with 8 rock chunks into a Fire Pit, set it on a flat 2x2 of ground and light it with the Fire Drill. Big light, big smoke, bigger raids
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.kiln.d: Craft a Clay Kiln (Clay Balls, rock chunks) and place it on a Campfire. Burn it 2 min at 500° before use
Bake a Clay Ball into a Brick in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.charco: Bake a Log or 2 Firewood into Charcoal in the kiln. The hottest fuel
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.clay_b: Shape 3 Clay Balls into an Unfired Clay Bucket and fire it in the kiln. It only carries water
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.mold_b: Craft a Mold Bench from Flint, a Clay block and Planks. Crucibles and clay molds are shaped there from Clay Balls
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.crucib: Shape an Unfired Crucible (7 Clay Balls) at the Mold Bench, fire it in the kiln at 800°: needs Charcoal or Bellows. The key to bronze
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.log_ra: Lash 6 logs together with 3 Cordage into a Log Raft
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.paddle: Carve a Rough Log into a Paddle with a knife
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.dugout: Mark a Fallen Log with a knife, then work it: axe, fire, axe, fire, axe, knife
Pick up Loose Red Ochre (badlands, savanna), Yellow Ochre (desert, rivers) or Chalk (shores, hills)
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.pigmen: Grind ochre, chalk or Charcoal with the Flint Pickaxe in the grid, or on a Stone Anvil
Mix 2 pigment with Tallow or water in a Bowl
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.cave_p: Paint in the off hand, right-click a wall with a Paintbrush (Stick + 2 Plant Fibre). Sneak to pick a motif
advancements.mechanical.stone_age.beaten: Walk the same way over grass a few dozen times until it wears into a Trodden Path. Paths are faster to walk on
Make a knife. Kill an animal and right-click its Carcass with the knife to butcher it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.butch: Butcher a Carcass with a knife: hides and feathers first, then meat scraps
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pluck: Pluck a Greylag Goose carcass with a knife, then take the Plucked Goose with an empty hand or cut it into Raw Goose
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bird_: Build a Bird Nest from Sticks and Straw near geese, pheasants, ptarmigans, rock doves or chickens: they claim it and lay in it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.scrap: Scrape a Raw Hide with a knife in the crafting grid
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.dryin: Build a Drying Rack and right-click it with a Scraped Hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leath: Take the dry Leather off the Drying Rack after about 3 minutes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve Fish Bones, a Bone or a Horn into a Bone Needle with a knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.armor: Craft an Armor Station from Leather, a Bone Needle, Planks and a Crafting Table
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leath: Sew Leather and Wool Thread (or String) into Leather armor at the Armor Station
Sew 4 Leather into a Leather Satchel: 9 slots that go with you
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.travo: Lash 4 Tool Rods, 2 Cordage and a Scraped Hide into a Travois to drag big carcasses home
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.hangi: Build a Hanging Rack (5 Tool Rods, Cordage) and hang a carried carcass on it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.prime: Butcher a carcass on the Hanging Rack: double meat as Haunch, Ribs and Loin
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snare: Set a Snare (2 Sticks, Cordage) where small game walks. Bait it with berries or seeds
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fishi: Fish with a Crude Fishing Rod (Tool Station: Flint + Twine + Tool Rod) or a Fish Trap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fish_: Craft a Fish Trap (6 Sticks, 2 Twine) and place it in open water, best in rivers
Gut a Whole fish with a knife in the crafting grid for fish and Fish Bones
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve a Bone Fish Hook, then Tool Station: hook + Twine + Tool Rod
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.flint: Tool Station: Flint + Cordage + Tool Rod. Sprint and hold right-click to charge
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.crude: Tool Station: Cordage + Twine + Tool Rod makes a Crude Bow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.arrow: Right-click a Fletching Table: Flint or bone + Stick + Feather makes 4 arrows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.sinew: Fletching Table: Sinew + Crude Bow + Cordage. Full arrow damage
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tallo: Cook Lard (Wild Boar) or Bear Fat on a Campfire into Tallow
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.candl: Craft Twine and 2 Tallow into Candles, light them with the Fire Drill
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tusk_: Butcher a Wild Boar for a Tusk. Tool Station: Tusk + Cordage + Leather makes a Tusk Dagger
Kill a Brown Bear and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger (or bronze knife) for its pelt, fat and claws
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bear_: Dry the Raw Bear Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day (it takes the whole rack)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fur_a: Sew Bear Pelt and Sinew into Fur armor at the Armor Station. Each piece blocks 25 % of the cold
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bear_: Craft a Bear Pelt and a Bear Claw into a Bear Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.barbe: Fletching Table: Bear Claw + Stick + Feather
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.raw_w: Kill a Grey Wolf (they hunt at night and fear fire) and butcher it for a Raw Wolf Pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wolf_: Dry the Raw Wolf Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day
Sew 2 Wolf Pelts and Sinew into a Wolf Hood at the Armor Station
Sew Wolf Pelts and Sinew into a Wolf Fur Coat, Leggings or Boots
Craft 2 Wolf Pelts and a Bone into a Wolf Rug. A pelt on a Straw Bed makes a warm Furred Straw Bed
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.phant: Kill a Phantom yourself and butcher it for Raw Phantom Hide
Scrape the hide and dry it on a Drying Rack, in daylight only
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.glide: Craft 4 Tool Rods, 2 Bones, Sinew and Cordage into a Glider Frame
Sew 6 Phantom Leather and the Glider Frame into a Glider Cloak at the Armor Station
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ancie: Find the great hollow oak. Trails lead to it from the villages
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Hunt the rare Giant Deer for its Giant Antler
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mythi: Offer the Giant Antler on the Offering Altar inside the Ancient Oak
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.undea: Kill a Brute: the rare huge zombie in a bearskin cape, slow but tough and hard to knock back
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.spear: Kill a skeleton charging with a Flint Spear. Now and then it drops the spear
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.tribe: Find a Tribe Village. Stay on good terms: camps that burn for days draw raiders
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bison: Butcher a Steppe Bison for its hide and the hunters' prize, the tongue. A panicked herd stampedes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pegge: A big raw hide (Bison, Musk Ox, Rhino, Mammoth) is too big for a rack: place it on the ground to peg it out, let it cure in the sun
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.giant: Make a Bison, Musk Ox or Mammoth Rug from its cured hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.qiviu: Butcher a Musk Ox for Qiviut, its fine underwool. Threatened, the herd closes into a ring around its calves
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.rhino: Hunt a Woolly Rhinoceros for its horn. Hurt it and it charges: step aside, and it may stun itself on a tree
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.hide_: Stretch a cured Rhino Hide over planks into a Shield
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.rhino: Lash a Rhino Horn onto a Tool Rod with Cordage: a slow, heavy club
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mammo: Bring down a Woolly Mammoth and butcher it for its Ivory. The herd's matriarch warns once, then charges
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ivory: Craft an Ivory Knife from Mammoth Ivory (with Cordage and Leather) or Walrus Ivory: a skinning knife that can cut bears
Carve Mammoth Ivory into an Ivory Figurine with a knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.mammo: Render Mammoth Fat into Tallow on a Campfire (3 per piece)
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lek_h: Stalk a singing Capercaillie cock at dawn (step in while he grinds, he hears nothing then) and pluck him for his Tail Feathers
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.great: Bag a Great Bustard on the open plains: it runs from you long before you are close. Pluck it for a big bird's worth of meat
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.owl_f: Bring down an Eagle-Owl as it hunts the forest at night, for its soft Owl Feathers
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.silen: Fletch Silent Arrows with Owl Feathers at the Fletching Table: a miss lands without a sound and startles nothing
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.eagle: Bring down a Golden Eagle (it may steal your small game!) for Eagle Feathers and Talons
Fletch Eagle-Fletched Arrows: the hardest-hitting flint arrows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.raven: Bind three Raven Feathers to a Bone with Twine. Carried, the dark wears on your mind more slowly
Sneak up on a Seal on a cold shore before it slips into the water, and butcher it for Raw Sealskin and Blubber
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.seals: Dry the Raw Sealskin on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day
Sew Sealskin and Sinew into a Sealskin Parka or Boots at the Armor Station: warm, and they keep out the chill of the water
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.oil_l: Craft an Oil Lamp (rock chunks, Plant Fibre), fill it with Blubber and light it with the Fire Drill
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.walru: Kill a Walrus on the frozen sea (it fights back) and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better for Ivory, Blubber and hide
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ivory: Craft Walrus Ivory, Twine and a Stick into an Ivory Knife
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.walru: Dry the Raw Walrus Hide on a tall Drying Rack (it takes the whole rack). A knife cuts it into 6 Cordage
Sew 2 Walrus Hide and Sinew into a Walrus Hide Cuirass at the Armor Station
Catch a Pike in a river, fen or swamp: on the hook, or sneak up and spear it
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.sturg: Spear one of the rare giant Sturgeons in a river and butcher it, or hook a young one, for its roe and Isinglass
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lemmi: Catch a Lemming on the snowy plains, in a Snare or by hand. Every eighth day they swarm
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.ermin: Skin an Ermine and cure its Raw Ermine Pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 6 Ermine Fur, Leather and Sinew into an Ermine Mantle: warm as fur and easy to enchant
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.marte: Hunt a Pine Marten (it runs up trees and robs bird nests) and cure its pelt on a Drying Rack
Sew 5 Marten Fur and Sinew into a warm Marten Fur Cap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wolve: Kill a Wolverine (it stands its ground and steals carcasses and snare bait) and skin it
Trim a Fur Hood with 2 cured Wolverine Fur and Sinew: frost never clings to it, no more freezing
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.claw_: Lash 2 Wolverine Claws, a Stick and Sinew into a skinning knife: more pelt and hide off every carcass
Kill a Lynx. It stalks lone wanderers at night: company, fire and torches keep it off
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lynx_: Cure 2 Lynx Pelts on a Drying Rack and craft them with a Bone into a Lynx Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wild_: Hunt the shy, night-prowling Wild Cat of forest edges and meadows and skin it for its pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.wildc: Flesh the pelt with a knife, then craft 2 Wildcat Pelts and Sinew into a Wildcat Fur Cap
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.moles: Catch a Mole: snare its runs, or dig up a fresh molehill to flush it out. Flesh its pelt into Moleskin
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.field: Catch a Field Vole, the pest that nibbles crops and raids chests by the fields at night
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snake: Butcher an Adder or a Grass Snake for Snakeskin
Craft Leather Boots, 2 Snakeskin and Sinew into Snakeskin Boots: an adder can't bite through them
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.venom: Kill an Adder, the viper of heaths and sunny meadows, and butcher it for its Venom Gland
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.poiso: Craft 8 arrows around a Venom Gland into Arrows of Poison
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.snake: Bind a Venom Gland, Lard and Plant Fibre into Snakebite Poultices. Eating one cures poison
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.pluck: Bring down a Mute Swan and pluck it: Down, a Swan Quill and a big Plucked Swan. Keep clear of its nest
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.down_: Pluck Down from a Mallard or Mute Swan. Laid in an unlit campfire, Fire Pit or kiln it is the best tinder
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.heron: Butcher a Grey Heron for its Heron Bill: a knife carves it into 2 Bone Fish Hooks
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.plume: Make a Plume Headdress from Heron Plumes, Down and Leather: herons and cranes let you come close
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.bone_: Carve a Hollow Bird Bone (swan, crane) or a Vulture Wing Bone into a Bone Flute. Playing it lifts the spirits around you
Get close to an Ibex on the peaks (it flees uphill, up the rock face) and butcher it for its Horns and pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.horn_: Fletching Table: 2 Sinew + Sinew Bow + 2 Ibex Horns makes the Horn Bow: its arrows fly faster and hit harder
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.fat_t: Work a raw Ibex, Saiga or Hyena pelt or a Raw Chamois Hide with a knife and fat (Tallow, Lard, Bear or Marmot Fat) in the grid
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.chamo: Sew 3 Chamois Leather and Sinew into Chamois Boots at the Armor Station: long falls hurt less
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.marmo: Catch a Marmot before its whistle sends the colony - and every animal around - running
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.saiga: Bring down a Saiga, the most skittish game of the steppe (take a bow), and take its amber horns
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.horn_: Set Saiga Horns in a lattice of sticks: Horn Windows let the light in
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.cave_: Wake a Cave Bear in its den under the mountains, survive, and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better: its skull is your trophy
Dry the Raw Cave Bear Pelt on a tall Drying Rack outdoors by day (it takes the whole rack)
Kill a Cave Hyena - they steal carcasses and harass you at night in packs - for its fangs and spotted pelt
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.torto: Butcher a Tortoise. Pulled into its shell it shrugs off most blows
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.shell: Bind a Tortoise Shell with gravel inside onto a stick: held in hand it keeps predators off like a torch
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.lizar: Grab at a Desert Lizard: it sheds its tail and escapes
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.water: Bring down a Water Buffalo (its whole herd will charge you) and butcher it with a Tusk Dagger or better
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.leopa: Kill a Leopard. It sleeps up in the trees by day and drops on its prey at dusk
Fat-tan 2 Raw Leopard Pelts with a knife and Tallow or Lard, then craft them with a Bone into a Leopard Rug
advancements.mechanical.wilderness.jungl: Pluck a Peacock for its eyed feathers, or a Hornbill for its casque
advancements.mechanical.food.root.title: Food & Farming
advancements.mechanical.food.root.descri: Pick wild berries, mushrooms or nuts. Fresh food spoils: raw meat in 1 day, berries in 2
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked.desc: Cook meat on a lit Campfire. Take it off with an empty hand before it burns
advancements.mechanical.food.burnt.title: Overdone
advancements.mechanical.food.burnt.descr: Leave food on the Campfire too long
advancements.mechanical.food.roasted.des: Roast mushrooms, hazelnuts or beechnuts on a Campfire
Boil an egg on the Campfire, then peel it in the crafting grid
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_bird: Cook Raw Goose, Pheasant, Ptarmigan or Pigeon on a Campfire, or roast a whole Plucked bird
advancements.mechanical.food.nest_egg.de: Take an egg from a wild Bird Nest (by rivers, in forests, on snow or bare rock). Leave one, or the birds may abandon it
advancements.mechanical.food.smoking_rac: Build a Smoking Rack (Sticks, Cordage) over or beside a burning Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.smoked.desc: Hang raw meat or fish on the Smoking Rack for 4 minutes. Keeps 30 days
advancements.mechanical.food.dried.title: Sun-Dried
advancements.mechanical.food.dried.descr: Put raw meat, fish, berries or mushrooms on a Drying Rack outdoors by day (faster in full sun). Keeps 30 days
advancements.mechanical.food.spoiled.des: Let food spoil. A Bark Basket or a sealed Storage Jar slows it down
Cut Wild Einkorn or Wild Emmer with a knife, or pick Wild Peas
advancements.mechanical.food.sow.title: Sower
advancements.mechanical.food.sow.descrip: Till soil with a hoe and sow grain or peas on the farmland
advancements.mechanical.food.sheaf.title: Harvest
advancements.mechanical.food.sheaf.descr: Harvest a ripe crop for a Sheaf. A sickle gives bonus sheaves and Straw
advancements.mechanical.food.flail.title: Threshing
advancements.mechanical.food.flail.descr: Hold sheaves in the off hand and right-click a hard surface with a Flail for grain and Straw
advancements.mechanical.food.straw_bed.d: Craft a Straw Bed (3 Straw, 3 Planks) and right-click it to rest: sets spawn, keeps Phantoms away
advancements.mechanical.food.porridge.de: Mix 2 Grain, a Clay Water Bucket and a Bowl, then cook it on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.wild_carrot: Dig up a Wild Carrot (white flower umbels on meadows and plains). A knife or sickle gets the whole root
advancements.mechanical.food.carrot.desc: Sow Wild Carrots on farmland. Now and then a ripe harvest gives a real Carrot
advancements.mechanical.food.sea_beet.de: Cut Sea Beet on a beach or stony shore: Sea Beet Leaves and sometimes Beetroot Seeds
advancements.mechanical.food.potato.desc: Potatoes don't grow wild here. A few tribe elders trade seed potatoes for Leather and an Antler
advancements.mechanical.food.root_cellar: Build a Root Cellar (Planks, Straw) and dig it into the ground: roots keep 4x longer, other food 2x
advancements.mechanical.food.manure.desc: Pick up Manure that livestock drop. Right-click farmland with it: fertility +2
advancements.mechanical.food.compost.des: Build a Compost Heap (Sticks, Leaf Litter, a copper ingot) and fill it with plant waste
advancements.mechanical.food.scarecrow.d: Build a Scarecrow (copper ingot bell, Carved Pumpkin, Straw, Raw Hide) to keep crows off the crops
advancements.mechanical.food.flour.title: Grind
advancements.mechanical.food.flour.descr: Build a Quern (Cobblestone, Stick, copper ingot axle) and grind Grain into Flour
advancements.mechanical.food.dough.title: Dough
advancements.mechanical.food.dough.descr: Mix 2 Flour and a Clay Water Bucket into Dough
advancements.mechanical.food.bread.title: Daily Bread
advancements.mechanical.food.bread.descr: Bake Dough on a Baking Stone beside a Campfire, or in the kiln at 200°
advancements.mechanical.food.hearty_stew: Simmer 4 or more ingredients in a Bronze Kettle of water over a fire, then ladle the stew out with a Bowl
Cook Mammoth, Rhino, Bison or Musk Ox meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.bison_tongu: Roast a Bison Tongue on a Campfire: the most filling cut of all
advancements.mechanical.food.forest_fowl: Cook Raw Capercaillie or Raw Bustard on a Campfire, or roast a whole Plucked one
advancements.mechanical.food.ground_nest: Take an egg from a Capercaillie nest on the pine-forest floor or a Great Bustard nest out in the grass
advancements.mechanical.food.sea_meat.de: Cook Seal or Walrus meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.caviar.desc: Take the roe from a Sturgeon: little food, but very filling
Cook the meat of a Lynx, Wolverine, Pine Marten, Ermine or Lemming on a Campfire
Roast Wildcat Meat, a Mole, a Vole or Snake Meat on the Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.cooked_wate: Cook Raw Mallard, Swan, Heron or Crane on a Campfire, or roast the whole Plucked bird
advancements.mechanical.food.swan_egg.de: Take an egg from a Mute Swan's nest without getting chased off
advancements.mechanical.food.mountain_me: Cook Ibex, Chamois, Marmot, Saiga, Cave Bear or Hyena meat on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.marmot_salv: Mix 2 Marmot Fat with Juniper Berries into Marmot Salve: rub it on to heal
advancements.mechanical.food.warm_fare.d: Cook the meat of an Onager, Tortoise, Water Buffalo, Tapir or Leopard, or a Lizard Tail, on a Campfire
advancements.mechanical.food.jungle_fowl: Pick up an egg a Jungle Fowl hen laid. Throw it: it may hatch a chick
Look for green Malachite or Native Copper among loose rocks: copper ore lies below
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.raw_c: Mine Copper Ore with a stone pickaxe for Raw Copper
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.pan.d: Craft a Pan from Planks and Twine
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.panni: Right-click Gravel or Sand with the Pan, then hold right-click in water for Cassiterite and copper
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stone: Craft a Stone Anvil from rock chunks and Cobblestone, with the Flint Pickaxe
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.crush: Put ore on the Stone Anvil and strike it 4 times with a pickaxe as hammerstone
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.conce: Hold an empty Pan and crushed ore in the other hand, use it in water. Worth double in the crucible
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tuyer: Shape 3 Clay Balls into an Unfired Clay Tuyere and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bello: Craft Bellows, set it facing the kiln's firebox and pump it: +40° per click
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.molds: Shape a mold from Clay Balls at the Mold Bench and fire it in the kiln (600°)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.molte: Click copper ore onto a Crucible and melt it in the kiln: copper needs 1085°
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Pour the molten crucible into a Clay Ingot Mold within 60 s
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rough: Pour molten copper into a tool head mold and take out the Rough Cast head
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.whets: Build a Whetstone from Sandstone, Sticks and Planks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.sharp: Right-click the Whetstone 4 times with a Rough Cast head
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.coppe: Tool Station: Copper Pickaxe Head + Cordage + Tool Rod. It mines Tin Ore
Assemble a Copper Axe, Shovel, Hoe or Knife at the Tool Station
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tin.d: Mine Tin Ore with the Copper Pickaxe and crush the Cassiterite on the Stone Anvil
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Melt about 9 parts copper and 1 part tin in a Crucible at 950° and cast it
Cast, sharpen and assemble a Bronze Pickaxe. It mines Iron Ore
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.raw_i: Mine Iron Ore with a Bronze Pickaxe. The Iron Age awaits
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Assemble a Bronze Axe, Shovel, Hoe or Knife (the knife can butcher bears)
Fire spear or sword molds, cast and sharpen, then assemble a Bronze Spear or Bronze Sword
Cast plates, sharpen them and sew a Bronze Helmet or Greaves at the Armor Station
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.furna: Shape Clay Balls and Sand into Unfired Furnace Bricks, fire them in the kiln (600°) and put 4 together
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.smelt: Build 3x3x3 Furnace Bricks around an open shaft, a Furnace Tap mid-bottom front. Drop ore and Charcoal in, light it
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tap_m: Sneak-use the tap to open it: molten metal runs along Clay Channels into a Clay Mold. A quarter more metal per ore
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.kettl: Shape a Clay Kettle Mold (28 Clay Balls) at the Mold Bench and fire it, pour 8 units of bronze into it and grind the casting on the Whetstone
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.hide_: Boil Raw Hide, Rabbit Hide or Fish Bones in the kettle. Hide Glue hafts tools in place of Cordage
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tanne: Boil Bark with Scraped Hides in the kettle: 3 Leather from every 2 hides, rain or shine
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.bronz: Cast a saw blade and assemble a Bronze Saw. Log + Saw makes 4 Planks
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.potte: Build a Potter's Wheel (Planks, Bronze Saw, Bronze Ingot, Cobblestone)
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.stora: Throw 4 Clay Balls on the wheel and fire the jar. Sealed, food spoils 4x slower
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.water: Throw 3 Clay Balls on the wheel and fire the jug. Holds 6 pours
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.woode: Craft a Wooden Wheel: Planks, Tool Rods, a Bronze Ingot hub and the Bronze Saw
Build a Wheeled Cart from 2 Wooden Wheels, Planks and Tool Rods
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.rope_: Craft 3 Cordage into a Rope Halter. Sneak up to a Wild Horse and feed it grain to earn its trust
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tame_: Halter a Wild Horse that trusts you and keep feeding it until it is tame
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.saddl: Craft a Hide Saddle Blanket (3 Leather, 2 Cordage) for full speed and jumps
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.tame_: Win over a skittish Onager with feed, halter it and keep feeding it until it is tame
advancements.mechanical.bronze_age.pack_: Sling Pack Baskets (2 Bark Baskets, Scraped Hide, Cordage) on a tame Onager: it carries your load
advancements.mechanical.hunting.root.des: Every animal gives its own meat, hide and parts: butcher one of each kind and collect them all
advancements.mechanical.hunting.small_ga: Butcher hares, squirrels and other small animals
advancements.mechanical.hunting.adder.de: Butcher a Adder: Raw Snake Meat, Snakeskin, Venom Gland
advancements.mechanical.hunting.badger.d: Butcher a Badger: Raw Hide, Game Meat Scraps, Lard
advancements.mechanical.hunting.desert_h: Butcher a Desert Hare: Rabbit Scraps, Rabbit Hide, Rabbit's Foot
advancements.mechanical.hunting.desert_l: Butcher a Desert Lizard: Lizard Tail, Lizard Skin
advancements.mechanical.hunting.ermine.d: Butcher a Ermine: Raw Ermine, Raw Ermine Pelt
advancements.mechanical.hunting.field_vo: Butcher a Field Vole: Raw Vole
advancements.mechanical.hunting.grass_sn: Butcher a Grass Snake: Raw Snake Meat, Snakeskin
advancements.mechanical.hunting.hare.des: Butcher a Hare: Rabbit Scraps, Rabbit Hide, Rabbit's Foot
advancements.mechanical.hunting.hedgehog: Butcher a Hedgehog: Game Meat Scraps
Butcher a Lemming: Raw Lemming, Lemming Pelt
advancements.mechanical.hunting.marmot.d: Butcher a Marmot: Marmot Meat, Marmot Pelt, Marmot Fat
advancements.mechanical.hunting.rabbit.d: Butcher a Rabbit: Rabbit Scraps, Rabbit Hide, Rabbit's Foot
advancements.mechanical.hunting.mole.des: Butcher a Mole: Raw Mole, Raw Mole Pelt
advancements.mechanical.hunting.pine_mar: Butcher a Pine Marten: Raw Marten, Raw Marten Pelt
advancements.mechanical.hunting.squirrel: Butcher a Squirrel: Game Meat Scraps, Squirrel Pelt
advancements.mechanical.hunting.tortoise: Butcher a Tortoise: Tortoise Meat, Tortoise Shell
advancements.mechanical.hunting.wild_cat: Butcher a Wild Cat: Raw Wildcat Meat, Raw Wildcat Pelt, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.deer.des: Butcher the deer of the woods and the tundra
advancements.mechanical.hunting.giant_de: Butcher a Giant Deer: Raw Hide, Game Meat Scraps, Giant Antler, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.moose.de: Butcher a Moose: Raw Hide, Venison Scraps, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.red_deer: Butcher a Red Deer: Raw Hide, Venison Scraps, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.reindeer: Butcher a Reindeer: Raw Hide, Venison Scraps, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.roe_deer: Butcher a Roe Deer: Raw Hide, Venison Scraps, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.big_game: Butcher aurochs, wild horses, boars and wild sheep
Butcher a Aurochs: Raw Hide, Beef Scraps, Sinew, Horn
Butcher a Chamois: Chamois Meat, Raw Chamois Hide, Chamois Horn, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.ibex.des: Butcher a Ibex: Ibex Meat, Raw Ibex Pelt, Ibex Horn, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.cow.desc: Butcher a Cow: Raw Hide, Beef Scraps
advancements.mechanical.hunting.mooshroo: Butcher a Mooshroom: Raw Hide, Beef Scraps
advancements.mechanical.hunting.pig.desc: Butcher a Pig: Raw Hide, Pork Scraps
advancements.mechanical.hunting.sheep.de: Butcher a Sheep: Raw Hide, Mutton Scraps, Wool Thread
Butcher a Mouflon: Raw Hide, Mutton Scraps, Wool Thread, Sinew, Horn
Butcher a Musk Ox: Raw Musk Ox Meat, Qiviut, Raw Musk Ox Hide, Horn, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.onager.d: Butcher a Onager: Onager Meat, Raw Onager Hide, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.saiga.de: Butcher a Saiga: Saiga Meat, Raw Saiga Pelt, Saiga Horn, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.steppe_b: Butcher a Steppe Bison: Raw Bison Meat, Raw Bison Hide, Bison Tongue, Horn, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.tapir.de: Butcher a Tapir: Tapir Meat, Raw Tapir Hide, Lard, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.water_bu: Butcher a Water Buffalo: Buffalo Meat, Raw Buffalo Hide, Buffalo Horn, Sinew, Lard
advancements.mechanical.hunting.wild_boa: Butcher a Wild Boar: Raw Hide, Pork Scraps, Lard, Tusk
advancements.mechanical.hunting.wild_hor: Butcher a Wild Horse: Raw Hide, Game Meat Scraps, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.predator: Butcher the hunters that hunt you
advancements.mechanical.hunting.brown_be: Butcher a Brown Bear: Raw Hide, Game Meat Scraps, Raw Bear Pelt, Bear Fat, Bear Claw, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.cave_bea: Butcher a Cave Bear: Cave Bear Meat, Raw Cave Bear Pelt, Raw Hide, Cave Bear Skull, Bear Fat, Bear Claw, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.cave_hye: Butcher a Cave Hyena: Hyena Meat, Raw Hyena Pelt, Hyena Fang, Bone, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.cave_lio: Butcher a Cave Lion: Raw Hide, Game Meat Scraps, Sinew, Bone
advancements.mechanical.hunting.grey_wol: Butcher a Grey Wolf: Game Meat Scraps, Raw Wolf Pelt, Sinew, Bone
Butcher a Leopard: Leopard Meat, Raw Leopard Pelt, Sinew, Bone
advancements.mechanical.hunting.lynx.des: Butcher a Lynx: Raw Lynx, Raw Lynx Pelt, Sinew
Butcher a Phantom: Rotten Flesh, Raw Phantom Hide, Phantom Membrane
advancements.mechanical.hunting.wolverin: Butcher a Wolverine: Raw Wolverine, Raw Wolverine Pelt, Wolverine Claw, Sinew
Bring down the mammoth and the woolly rhinoceros
advancements.mechanical.hunting.woolly_m: Butcher a Woolly Mammoth: Raw Mammoth Meat, Raw Mammoth Hide, Mammoth Wool, Mammoth Ivory, Mammoth Fat, Sinew, Bone
advancements.mechanical.hunting.woolly_r: Butcher a Woolly Rhinoceros: Raw Rhino Meat, Raw Rhino Hide, Rhino Horn, Sinew, Bone
advancements.mechanical.hunting.waters.d: Butcher seals, walruses and the great river fish
advancements.mechanical.hunting.seal.des: Butcher a Seal: Raw Seal Meat, Raw Sealskin, Blubber, Sinew
advancements.mechanical.hunting.sturgeon: Butcher a Sturgeon: Raw Sturgeon, Raw Hide, Sturgeon Roe, Isinglass, Fish Bones
advancements.mechanical.hunting.walrus.d: Butcher a Walrus: Raw Walrus Meat, Raw Walrus Hide, Walrus Ivory, Blubber, Sinew, Bone
advancements.mechanical.hunting.capercai: Butcher a Capercaillie: Raw Capercaillie, Feather, Capercaillie Tail Feather
advancements.mechanical.hunting.common_c: Butcher a Common Crane: Feather, Raw Crane, Hollow Bird Bone
advancements.mechanical.hunting.goose.de: Butcher a Greylag Goose: Feather, Raw Goose
advancements.mechanical.hunting.great_bu: Butcher a Great Bustard: Raw Bustard, Feather
advancements.mechanical.hunting.grey_her: Butcher a Grey Heron: Feather, Raw Heron, Heron Plume, Heron Bill
advancements.mechanical.hunting.hornbill: Butcher a Hornbill: Raw Hornbill, Feather, Hornbill Casque
advancements.mechanical.hunting.jungle_f: Butcher a Jungle Fowl: Raw Jungle Fowl, Feather
Butcher a Mallard: Feather, Raw Mallard, Down
Butcher a Chicken: Feather, Raw Chicken
advancements.mechanical.hunting.parrot.d: Butcher a Parrot: Feather, Game Meat Scraps
advancements.mechanical.hunting.mute_swa: Butcher a Mute Swan: Feather, Raw Swan, Down, Swan Quill, Hollow Bird Bone
Butcher a Peafowl: Raw Peafowl, Feather, Peacock Feather
advancements.mechanical.hunting.pheasant: Butcher a Pheasant: Feather, Raw Pheasant
advancements.mechanical.hunting.ptarmiga: Butcher a Willow Ptarmigan: Feather, Raw Ptarmigan
advancements.mechanical.hunting.rock_dov: Butcher a Rock Dove: Feather, Raw Pigeon
